purpose: Teach: 殴ら/混沌/露骨/濫用/在留/誘発/解任/権益

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員が殴られた事案は絶対に許さん
lines.en: If any staff member is assaulted, it will not be tolerated.
lines.style: Measured authority. Flat, unwavering tone on the core statement. Pauses deliberately between clauses. No room for negotiation in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の混沌とした状況に対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to the market disruption.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment. Crisp, professional. Level eye contact implied. Brisk forward momentum—no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 露骨な競合の妨害行為に注意しろ
lines.style: Sharp warning. Slight edge on 'explicit'—not accusatory, but precise. Brief, commanding cadence. The tone of someone who's seen this before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内規程の濫用を防止しております
lines.en: Yes. We're preventing misuse of internal policy.
lines.style: Steady status report. Professional confidence underneath. Even pacing. Demonstrates competence without overstating.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 在留資格のある社員を支援しろ
lines.en: Support our employees with valid residency status.
lines.style: Clear directive. Firm but not cold. Weight on 'support'—this matters. Brief pause after, letting it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品が市場を誘発する効果を狙います
lines.en: Yes. We're aiming to have the new product drive market demand.
lines.style: Forward-looking explanation. Slightly more energy than before. Strategic confidence. The tone of someone laying out a plan.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不正役員は解任しろ
lines.en: Remove any fraudulent executives from our company.
lines.style: Cold, final statement. No hesitation or softening. The words themselves carry the weight—delivery is matter-of-fact. This is decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外の権益保護に注力しております
lines.en: Yes. We're focusing our efforts on protecting overseas assets.
lines.style: Closing statement. Professional wrap-up. Steady, confident. Implies competence and follow-through without needing elaboration.
